name: popconfirm
title: Popconfirm
description: A small are-you-sure bubble anchored to the button that was pressed. Lighter than an alert dialog.
htmlExample:
<bef-popconfirm title="Delete this invoice?" description="This cannot be undone." confirm-label="Delete" destructive id="g1">
  <bef-button variant="outline">Delete invoice</bef-button>
</bef-popconfirm>
<script type="module">
document.getElementById("g1").props = {
  onConfirm: () => befui.toast.success("Invoice deleted"),
};
</script>
